title: P3582PW corn (Pioneer P3582PW): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: P3582PW corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: P3582PW corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Luzon and Mindanao. 106 to 108 days to harvest, 8.3 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: P3582PW corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as Pioneer P3582PW or Pioneer 3582. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2023 as NSIC 2023 GMCn 89. Corteva Agriscience bred it. It takes 106 to 108 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 8.26 tonnes per hectare in the trials (11.06 in Luzon, 5.45 in Mindanao).

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Pioneer P3582PW or Pioneer 3582, this is the same corn. Its seller and farm sources add notes, listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

items: **Days to harvest:** 106 to 108 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 8.26 tonnes per hectare in the trials (11.06 in Luzon, 5.45 in Mindanao).
**Plant height:** about 213.8 cm.
**Recommended for:** Luzon and Mindanao.
**Type:** Yellow GM hybrid.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

P3582PW corn takes 106 to 108 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 8.26 t/ha matches the average of its group, 8.13. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives 116 to 120 days after planting (Pioneer), 106 to 108 in national trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 15.2 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 84 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** Potential 14 t/ha (Pioneer), national trials 11.06 t/ha Luzon, 5.45 Mindanao.

**Traits in the seed:** PowerCore (MON 89034 x TC1507 x NK603): three Bt proteins (Cry1A.105, Cry2Ab2, Cry1F) against corn borer, earworm, fall armyworm and other caterpillars, plus glyphosate (Roundup) tolerance, sold as a 95:5 refuge seed blend.
**Season:** Wet and dry.
**Where:** All of Luzon and the Visayas, low areas of Mindanao.
Big ears and kernels, 18 to 20 rows.
Dense, heavy grain.
Spacing 70 x 20 cm or 60 x 22 cm.
Shelling about 84 percent in national trials.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: on the Jan 2025 list and Pioneer's current Philippine list, topped the GM class of DA 12's 2025 dry season trial in Sarangani (6.42 t/ha). These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant P3582PW corn

It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Pioneer P3582PW the same as P3582PW?
items.a: Yes. Pioneer P3582PW is another name for P3582PW, registered as NSIC 2023 GMCn 89. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 106 to 108 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 8.26 tonnes per hectare in the trials (11.06 in Luzon, 5.45 in Mindanao). Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of P3582PW?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
